notes: Adding incremental stories for robustness, observability, and failure handling.

stories.title: Tool Validation Error Handling and Response Standardization
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling for invalid tool inputs, including structured error responses when Pydantic validation fails or when a tool is not in the allowlist.

stories.title: Tool Router Observability and Debug Logging Integration
stories.description: Integrate debug logging into the tool router to capture tool selection, validation outcomes, and dispatch results for traceability and troubleshooting.

stories.title: Allowlist Security Enforcement Audit Checks
stories.description: Add safeguards to ensure no dynamic or runtime tool injection can bypass the allowlist, including explicit rejection paths and audit-safe defaults.

stories.title: Conversation Context Injection into Tool Execution
stories.description: Ensure chat history and relevant context are correctly injected into tool execution flows without violating validation constraints or allowlist enforcement.
